plan: This is a second-price sealed-bid auction (Vickrey auction) where I pay the second-highest bid if I win. The dominant strategy in this type of auction is to bid exactly my true value, regardless of what others do. Bidding higher risks paying more than the item is worth to me; bidding lower risks losing auctions I could have profitably won. With a value of $6, bidding truthfully ensures I only win when profitable and never overpay.

Bidding my value ensures I win whenever it's profitable (when my value exceeds the second-highest bid) and never overpay, since I only pay the second-highest bid, not my own bid. My value is $40, so I will bid $40.
